text:
tara: heads up from monitoring: unexpected IAM grant on KMS key `projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/pay-keys` — principal vendor-sync@external got roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter at 2026-04-02T04:12Z per admin audit. possible vendor sync gone wrong.
ben: OMG. that key is used by Vault transit for several DB creds and by snapshot encryption. can someone paste the audit entry?
lee: paste:
```
{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy","principalEmail":"vendor-sync@external","resourceName":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/pay-keys","request":{"policy":"...","bindings":[{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:vendor-sync@external"]}]}} , "timestamp":"2026-04-02T04:12:03Z"}
```
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly score: 0.94. Unusual principal for this key; recommended steps: snapshot key metadata, list dependent CMEK resources, revoke binding after ephemeral ops-SA ready, and create incident INC-2026-098.
tara: containment plan suggestion: 1) create ephemeral ops-SA with limited KMS rewrap rights 2) grant to SRE for rewrap ops 3) revoke vendor binding 4) rewrap ciphertexts to new key 5) rotate Vault wrapping keys and any service tokens.
infra-oncall: agree with staged approach. note: backups and snapshots may fail during rotation; schedule a canary in low-traffic window.
ben: quick inventory command I ran:
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:pay-keys" --format=json
```
results: vault-transit-payments, backups-payments-2024, snapshots-db-payments, export-bucket-ledger, billing-worker-fn.
lee: vendor claims the change was part of their sync script. vendor-sec: can you confirm their terraform plan/logs?
vendor-sec: reaching out to vendor for logs. also recommending we require terraform state-locked IAM changes going forward.
rotor-bot: created incident INC-2026-098 and paged sre-lead.
sre-lead: oncall here. I'm standing up ephemeral ops-SA now. will grant minimal kms.cryptoKeyVersion.* required for rewrap and rm policy after.
tara: please also snapshot audit logs for last 60 days for this key and set retention to 90d while we investigate.
lee: running rewrap dry-run to estimate time. command we'll use:
```
python tools/rewrap.py --src pay-keys --dst pay-keys-rot-20260402 --resources ./pay-keys-resources.json --workers 8 --dry-run
```
ben: dry-run shows ~420 wrapped objects across resources. estimated real run w/parallelism 8 -> ~45m.
sre-lead: proceeding with staged revoke: 1) create ops-SA (done) 2) grant ops-SA to our team 3) revoke vendor binding at T+5m 4) start rewrap canary against export-bucket-ledger.
infra-oncall: revoke executed at 4419000501. monitoring for failures.
ben: one function did fail immediately, restarted it and it picked up new service account creds. probably cached KMS GRPC connection; restarted fixed it.
lee: canary rewrap started:
```
python tools/rewrap.py --src pay-keys --dst pay-keys-rot-20260402 --resources ./canary-resources.json --workers 4
```
rotor-bot: [automated] detected no unwrap requests by vendor principals after revoke.
tara: good. sam (token ops) please enumerate which apps read KMS-wrapped secrets so we can rotate service tokens.
ben: I've prepared a token rotation playbook and a canary rollout plan. will open PR with runbook steps and smoke tests.
vendor-sec: vendor provided logs showing a config-sync yesterday that included an apply step. they claim the IAM binding was added by their automation due to missing conditional in their module. we need to update vendor onboarding and require IAM conditions for cross-project grants.
lee: next actions: - finish rewrap for all resources overnight - rotate Vault transit keys and DB creds by canary groups tomorrow morning - update alerting to flag cross-project KMS grants without conditions - increase KMS audit retention to 90d and export to secure archive.
sre-lead: noted. postmortem: we will create a blameless writeup, update vendor onboarding checklist (terraform state lock + condition enforcement), and add test in CI to detect unconditional cross-project grants.
tara: uploaded audit export for forensics: https://logs.internal.company/exports/pay-keys-441900.json :lock:
infra-oncall: rewrap complete for listed resources at 4419000820. starting token rotations now.
ben: canary rotations passed for billing-worker-fn and vault-transit-payments. no downstream errors observed.
vendor-sec: opening a follow-up with vendor to patch their module; require signed attestation for any future IAM changes.
tara: thanks all — keeping this thread as the coordination point. will add incident timeline and action items to INC-2026-098. closing once all rotations and vendor actions are confirmed. :thumbsup:
